name: Professor Ved
description: The channel's explainer. Late 20s to early 30s, fit (broad shoulders, slim waist, not bulky). Black side-swept quiff, short groomed Italian-style stubble beard, round gold spectacles. Formal-boss-casual: crisp white shirt with the top button open and sleeves rolled below the elbow, black trousers, black belt, black shoes, gold watch on his left wrist. Semi-realistic 2D, warm key light from the left.
